issues: scripts/winenvs/claudeteam.ps1:112-115 -> In the remote role pane branch, Invoke-ClaudeTeamRemoteLoop runs and then returns without Remove-ClaudeTeamPidFile. The loop returns on a missing python, a missing ssh.exe or an empty secret (ClaudeTeamCommon.ps1:1750-1762), and its documented stop is Ctrl-C (:1766), which ends the script before :198 in every case. The -NoExit shell then keeps <session>.pid, Test-ClaudeTeamPidFile still reports it live, and the remote role shows 'running' forever and never restarts. This is the blocker-(1) / DESIGN §3.2 defect ('a pane's -NoExit shell alone does not count') for remote roles. Linux has no such gap because claudeteam.sh:141 exits the pane after the loop. Fix: after Initialize-ClaudeTeamPane succeeds, wrap the pane body (the remote loop and `& claude`) in try { ... } finally { Remove-ClaudeTeamPidFile -Session $paneRow.Session }. finally also runs on Ctrl-C and on terminating errors under ErrorActionPreference Stop. Then drop the separate call at :198 and extend the SPW-023 wording to remote panes.
